baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active participle دافع is the sole rooted word, and ما له من exhaustively negates an agent available to the referent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The primary branch supplies displacement, prevention, and protection from harm, so the line denies effective warding rather than merely absent companionship.

activation_trace.role: Pushing something aside and warding harm supplies the literal action and defines the missing agent as an effective protector.

changed_reading.before: There is no helper for it.
changed_reading.after: There is no agent able to push the harm off its course or shield against it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دافع can be heard against root branches of driven advance and mutually pressing surges.
baseline_models.mechanism: The absent dāfiʿ is not only a person but a counterforce: nothing can arrest, reverse, or absorb momentum already moving toward an endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Driven motion toward an endpoint makes the referent a trajectory and the missing dāfiʿ its unrealized counter-thrust.
A wave or crowd whose parts press onward scales the negation from personal defense to resistance against a surging system.

changed_reading.before: No person will fend it off.
changed_reading.after: No counterforce can stop the advancing momentum or turn it back.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root can describe handing something over, although the focus lacks the branch's usual إلى frame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negated agent can be modeled as a transferee or conveyor who would move the attached consequence onto another recipient.

activation_trace.role: Handing or delivering an item to another supplies a transfer operation whose agent the focus construction negates.

changed_reading.before: The event cannot be stopped.
changed_reading.after: The event or liability cannot be handed away to a different bearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A form-distant دفع branch treats putting off a request as repeated deferral, leaving a temporal possibility latent in دافع.
baseline_models.mechanism: The missing agent would not cancel the event but keep postponing its demand; the negation removes that temporal buffer.

activation_trace.role: Putting a claimant off by delay supplies postponement as the missing function rather than physical resistance.

changed_reading.before: Nothing can prevent it.
changed_reading.after: Nothing can keep putting it off or purchase another interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root inventory includes channels and low outflows under دفع, despite the focus surface being an agentive participle.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dāfiʿ can be imagined materially as an outlet through which a driven accumulation escapes or disperses.

activation_trace.role: Water channels and outflows supply a pressure-release path whose absence would make the event materially inescapable.

changed_reading.before: No defender exists.
changed_reading.after: No outlet exists through which the accumulating force can be bled off.

context_deltas.mechanism: Binding inscription, aligned writing, and an opened spread turn repelling into attempted cancellation of a course already fixed and exposed.

activation_trace.role: Warding supplies the cancellation attempt that the inscription sequence renders ineffective.
An inscription that establishes a binding judgment supplies fixation and makes resistance resemble trying to annul what has been imposed.
Writing arranged in a line supplies an ordered course rather than an improvised threat.
Opening and spreading makes the fixed content manifest, functioning as activation rather than private storage.

structural_cues: The oath sequence places written, lined, and spread material before the assertion that the punishment is occurring and has no dāfiʿ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding inscription, ordered lines, and opening; I supply the arrow from publication to practical irreversibility. A live alternative is that the sequence proves the event without itself fixing it.

changed_reading.before: No force can physically push the event away.
changed_reading.after: No revising or erasing act can cancel a course already fixed, ordered, and opened into effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: A filled or kindled sea is followed by oscillating sky and traveling mountains; the focus surge branches now describe a system whose fluids, canopy, and solids all enter motion.

activation_trace.role: Surging waves or crowds provide the organizing mechanics for a many-part event that presses itself onward.
Vast abundant water supplies the large material reservoir from which surge and pressure can be imagined.
Filling with water supplies saturation, removing spare capacity that might absorb further force.
Oscillation and wave motion transfer instability from the reservoir to the sky's movement.
Going and flowing makes even the mountains participants in the trajectory rather than barriers to it.
A high solid mass supplies the strongest apparent resistance, whose movement demonstrates that solidity no longer arrests the system.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from sea saturation through sky oscillation to the locomotion of mountains, crossing liquid, canopy, and solid domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies saturation, oscillation, locomotion, and solidity; I infer a coupled surge in which ordinary barriers join the motion. The alternative is a sequence of separate images with no shared mechanics.

changed_reading.before: No defender can block an approaching punishment.
changed_reading.after: No counterforce or stable terrain can arrest the event once the whole material system, including its usual barriers, is moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The violent cognate shove toward fire activates دفع as a contest of vectors: the context supplies propulsion toward an endpoint while the focus denies any reverse push.

activation_trace.role: Driven movement toward an endpoint supplies the trajectory that the later violent shove makes concrete.
A severe push supplies the operative force and makes the missing dāfiʿ an absent opposing thrust.
Kindled fire supplies the fixed destination of the one-way propulsion.

structural_cues: 52:13 repeats the pushing verb with its cognate adverb and gives that force an explicit destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severe shove and destination; I infer vector opposition, assigning the unattested reverse arrow to the missing dāfiʿ. A live alternative is that 52:13 only illustrates coercion after arrival.

changed_reading.before: Nobody can generally ward the event off.
changed_reading.after: The only effective push is toward the endpoint; no reverse thrust can cancel or redirect it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event belongs to the Lord, yet the same Lord repeatedly wards selected people from it; the negation therefore targets rival counterforce, not an inability of the event's sovereign to control exposure.

activation_trace.role: Protection from harm supplies the apparent absolute that later instances of divine warding force the reader to rescope.
Nurturing, setting right, and bringing to completion supply sovereign administration of the event rather than external opposition to it.
Warding damage by protection supplies an explicit successful protection that coexists with the focus negation.
Repeated warding confirms that protection occurs by the Lord's act, not by a counter-agent overpowering the event.

structural_cues: 52:7 grammatically associates the event with the Lord, while 52:18 and 52:27 repeat that the Lord protected people from punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership and successful divine warding; I infer a scope distinction between sovereign exemption and rival repulsion. The alternative is a narrower temporal distinction between protection beforehand and impossibility only after arrival.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is absolutely unprotectable against.
changed_reading.after: No independent force can repel the Lord's event, although the Lord may prevent it from reaching particular people.

context_deltas.mechanism: Substitution is lexically available, and descendants can be joined without reducing deeds, yet each person remains held by acquisition; the transfer branch of دفع becomes a denied surrogate operation.

activation_trace.role: Handing something to another supplies the hypothetical transfer by which a consequence might be moved to a surrogate.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the live substitution possibility tested by the later accounting structure.
A later party reaching and joining those ahead supplies permitted relational reunion without yet implying transferred liability.
Diminution supplies the accounting operation explicitly denied when reunion occurs.
Acquiring one's own gain anchors consequence to the person's activity.
A pledge held against a right supplies the mechanism by which each person remains attached to what was acquired.

structural_cues: 52:21 places family attachment, no diminution of work, individual acquisition, and pledged status in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, reunion, preserved accounts, acquisition, and pledge; I infer that reunion does not permit consequence transfer. A live alternative is that this accounting only describes reward and does not rescope 52:8.

changed_reading.before: No one can stop the collective event.
changed_reading.after: No transferee or surrogate can take over the personally attached consequence, even where relationships are restored.

context_deltas.mechanism: Waiting for a cutting endpoint is answered by reciprocal waiting, then by marked times and the recession of a cycle; the delay branch of دفع becomes the failed hope that expectancy itself extends the interval.

activation_trace.role: Putting a demand off supplies temporal deferral as the missing function.
Cutting or ending an extension supplies the terminal edge for which the opponents wait.
Waiting and watching supplies the attempted temporal strategy without any power to change the endpoint.
Watching for a time supplies disciplined expectancy as a contrast to postponement.
The end and passing consequence of a thing supplies a cycle that reaches its rear boundary rather than being indefinitely deferred.

structural_cues: 52:30-31 repeats waiting as challenge and counterchallenge; the close of the surah marks appointed moments and the recession of the stars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies waiting, a cutting endpoint, marked time, and cyclical recession; I infer that waiting approaches rather than postpones the endpoint. The alternative is that the closing time cues concern worship only.

changed_reading.before: No one can prevent the event once it comes.
changed_reading.after: No postponing agent can convert watchful delay into extra time; every interval still runs into its endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The questions deny controlling oversight, custody of stores, an access ladder, privileged audition, and compelling authority; dāfiʿ becomes an institutional interposer who would need both access and mandate.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm supplies the proposed intervention whose chain of access and authority is dismantled.
A dominant overseer's control supplies the highest administrative form of a possible interposer.
A custodian responsible for preservation supplies control of resources needed for intervention.
A ladder as means of ascent supplies upstream access to the decision domain.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies privileged receipt of an actionable command.
Power and delegated authority supply the mandate without which access cannot become effective repulsion.

structural_cues: 52:37-38 forms a chain of rhetorical questions from possession and control to access, hearing, and authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies control, custody, access, audition, and authority; I arrange them as prerequisites for intervention. A live alternative is that these questions challenge knowledge claims only, not an imagined chain of command.

changed_reading.before: No physically strong defender can repel it.
changed_reading.after: No controller, custodian, privileged listener, or authorized intermediary has the access and mandate to interpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped branch supplies deflection at the very point where plotters intend a scheme; the scheme reverses onto them, then proves neither sufficient nor supported.

activation_trace.role: Pushing aside and preventing supplies the intended countermove that the context captures and reverses.
The split mapping's non-dominant branch of turning aside, pushing, and preventing creates a direct but exploratory semantic contact with دفع.
Deceptive contrivance supplies an intentional counter-strategy, while the active-to-passive repetition marks its reversal onto its makers.
Sufficiency supplies the efficacy test that their plot fails.
Aid and vindicating support supply the coalition backup also denied to the countermove.

structural_cues: 52:42 reverses the same plot lexeme from what they intend to what is done to them; 52:46 later denies that plot any efficacy and denies aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split deflection branch, plot reversal, insufficiency, and no aid; I infer a feedback arrow in which attempted repulsion is captured by the event. The alternative is ordinary retaliation with no semantic activation from the non-dominant mapping.

changed_reading.before: No countermove succeeds against the event.
changed_reading.after: The attempted countermove is not merely weak: it is folded back onto its makers and leaves neither efficacy nor supporting force.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible falling fragment is verbally recoded as stacked cloud; this makes interpretation itself a proposed dāfiʿ, but changing the category does not alter the object's downward course.

activation_trace.role: Physical warding supplies the result that the opponents seek through verbal reframing but cannot produce.
Direct visual perception supplies contact with the material sign before it is renamed.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies the threatening object that requires more than a semantic defense.
Falling and being cast downward supplies an objective trajectory unaffected by its label.
Saying what was not so supplies the defensive recategorization.
Things piled one above another supply the benign cloud category projected onto the falling fragment.

structural_cues: Within 52:44, seeing precedes object identification, falling, speech, and a substitute classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perception, a detached falling object, false speech, and stacking; I infer that relabeling functions psychologically as attempted deflection. The live alternative is simple denial with no claim that language was expected to alter events.

changed_reading.before: No external defender can push the event away.
changed_reading.after: No act of seeing-as or naming-as can deflect the material course of what is descending.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial of another deity and of partnership raises the absent dāfiʿ from tactical helper to hypothetical co-sovereign; none exists outside the authority from which the event comes.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm supplies the rival action that would require an authority capable of opposing the event's source.
Deity and object of worship supply the level of authority a genuine counter-sovereign would require.
Otherness and exception supply the proposed outside authority that the question rejects.
Exoneration and transcendence remove the attributed rival relation from God.
Partnership supplies the shared-power arrangement whose absence explains why no equal counter-agent can arise.

structural_cues: 52:43 asks about another deity, negates otherness through praise, and closes by rejecting partnership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deity, otherness, transcendence, and partnership; I infer that effective repulsion would require co-sovereignty. A live alternative is that 52:43 is a separate worship argument rather than an explanation of 52:8.

changed_reading.before: No helper happens to be available.
changed_reading.after: No co-sovereign exists outside the event's source with equal authority to countermand it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close does not answer unrepellability with passivity: it commands endurance under judgment, locates the addressee within protective sight, and marks worship through the cycle's recession. Agency moves from countermanding the event to aligned response within care.

activation_trace.role: Impossible repulsion supplies the action humans cannot perform and against which the closing imperatives define another kind of agency.
Holding the self against panic supplies active endurance rather than an attempt to reverse judgment.
Prevention and return for correction supply disciplined governance, distinguishing the Lord's judgment from uncontrolled force.
The eye of preservation and care supplies protection of the responder without implying repulsion of the decree.
Worship through glorification supplies the commanded use of agency inside the unaltered temporal order.
The passing end of a thing supplies the temporal boundary through which aligned action continues.

structural_cues: After denying plot efficacy and aid, 52:48-49 gives imperatives, protective framing, and actions tied to rising and recession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endurance, judgment, protective sight, worship, and temporal recession; I infer a reallocation rather than elimination of agency. The alternative is a devotional close unrelated to the mechanics of repulsion.

changed_reading.before: If the event cannot be repelled, human action is simply futile.
changed_reading.after: Unrepellability removes countermanding agency but leaves active endurance, worship, and protected alignment within the governing order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because agentive دافع is read through a branch about channels rather than a defender; it remains root-anchored and gains material support from the filled sea and oscillatory flow. Render it only as a hydraulic analogy for pressure release, not as a lexical replacement for the active participle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 carries root د ف ع, whose B006 inventory preserves water channels and outflows.

activation_trace.role: A drainage channel supplies the missing pressure-release path.
Vast abundant water supplies the reservoir whose pressure would ordinarily seek an outlet.
Filling removes unused capacity and makes release mechanics salient.
Repeated flowing and pouring supplies unstable movement inside the saturated system.

changed_reading.before: No person can defend against the event.
changed_reading.after: There is no drain or release path through which the event's accumulated pressure can harmlessly disperse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because B007 describes a person whom others push away, while the focus surface is an active participle; it remains attached to the same root and becomes socially coherent beside individual pledge accounting. Render it as a possible anti-scapegoat mechanism, explicitly noting the active-passive distance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sole focus root includes a branch for a despised person pushed away by everyone, activating a social disposal image within دافع.

activation_trace.role: The socially rejected person supplies the candidate expendable buffer whom a group might push forward or away.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the surrogate slot that the model tests and rejects.
The individual person supplies the unit to which the accounting statement attaches.
A pledge held for a right makes each person answerable and blocks use of a socially disposable substitute.

changed_reading.before: No defender can stand between the event and its targets.
changed_reading.after: No rejected or expendable person can be pushed into the middle as a surrogate buffer for another's attached consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly surprising because it links remote inventory branches about milk before birth and labor sounds, neither of which is the contextual surface sense; the repeated material pattern is nevertheless branch-backed and anchored in focus B009. Render it only as an analogy for latent onset before visible culmination, never as physiology or direct exegesis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B009 branch describes milk driven into the udder shortly before birth, making دافع a marker of internally advancing emergence.

activation_trace.role: Pre-birth milk driven into place supplies a latent process already advancing before outward culmination.
Pleasant milk before birth repeats the pre-manifest material stage and strengthens the latent-onset analogy.
A she-camel's cry at labor supplies the threshold where internal pressure becomes irreversible emergence.

changed_reading.before: The event begins only when it visibly arrives.
changed_reading.after: The event may already be advancing internally before manifestation, so the absence of a repeller reaches back into its latent onset.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because focus B010 concerns a prized camel spared from loading and the focus form is not that passive noun; debt and burden nevertheless create a coherent exemption test. Render it as a social-material analogy for privileged unloading, with the form distance stated, not as a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root includes B010, the honored camel set aside and not loaded, which activates exemption from burden as a remote possibility.

activation_trace.role: The honored animal spared from carrying supplies a model of status-based exemption from load.
An inescapable financial liability supplies the obligation that seeks an exemption.
Loading a heavy burden supplies the concrete weight from which privileged sparing would release a bearer.

changed_reading.before: No one can push the event away.
changed_reading.after: No status-based exemption can have a bearer honorably unloaded from the consequence once it binds.

strongest_changes: The violent push of 52:13 converts generic warding into one-way propulsion with no reverse thrust.
Repeated divine warding revises absolute unprotectability into an asymmetry: no rival repels the event, while its Lord can control whom it reaches.
The plot sequence turns counteraction into reversal: intended deflection folds back onto its makers and then lacks both efficacy and aid.
The closing imperatives prevent a fatalistic reading by reallocating agency from countermanding the event to endurance and worship under protective care.
summary.what_was_special: A single active participle sustained coexisting physical, temporal, transactional, institutional, social, and material mechanisms. The most diagnostic activations came from the near-echo of violent pushing, successful divine protection beside denied rival protection, and the non-dominant رد mapping embedded in the plot-reversal sequence; remote branches also preserved hydraulic, scapegoat, pre-manifest, and exemption outliers without promoting them to lexical glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer and accounting model may describe reward bookkeeping rather than rescope the punishment referred to by له.
The inscription model depends on a reader-supplied arrow from being written and spread to causal irreversibility.
The outlet, scapegoat, pre-birth, and spared-load readings rely on branch images distant from the active participle's immediate syntax and must remain analogical.
The exact boundary between protection before attachment and impossible repulsion after attachment remains open.
